card.name: Last word of fixed idioms
card.fires_on: The final word of a set phrase or idiom right after its opening words, such as 'beyond the pale', 'up to the mark', 'absent without leave', 'above-the-fold'. Also the end of a word cut partway in headings.

modes.label: Idiom endings
modes.description: The closing word of a stock phrase that is highly predictable from the words before it.
